description: 道路・橋梁の状況 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 生駒市. 舗装率は、舗装延長／総延長×１００による。 資料：県道路管理課、奈良国道事務所、奈良県道路公社、建設部管理課. Coverage: 生駒市. The portal files it under the publisher 生駒市. Its tags are 道路, 都市計画. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2026-05-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
